categories.main_business_segments: Jiangxi Fushine Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: pharmaceutical manufacturing focusing on anti-infective raw materials and intermediates, lithium battery electrolyte additives for the new energy sector, and synthetic biology-based microbial protein production. The pharmaceutical segment includes β-lactamase inhibitors and carbapenem antibiotics, while the new energy segment produces key lithium battery additives such as VC and FEC. The microbial protein segment focuses on sustainable alternative proteins with applications in food and health products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced chemical synthesis and biotechnological methods, including proprietary continuous flow enzymatic asymmetric synthesis for key intermediates like tazobactam. It has developed patented microbial strains for protein fermentation and uses enzyme conversion technology to recycle waste into amino acid fertilizers. In lithium battery additives, it utilizes mature chemical processes for halogenation, material separation, and purification, maintaining high product quality and cost efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include international pharmaceutical companies such as Fresenius Kabi and Aurobindo Pharma, and major domestic pharmaceutical firms like Zhuhai United Laboratories and Qilu Pharmaceutical. The lithium battery additives serve leading battery manufacturers and suppliers in the automotive and energy storage sectors. The microbial protein products target food manufacturers producing plant-based meat, protein beverages, and health supplements, with expanding domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing bases in Jiangxi, Shandong, Zhejiang, and Liaoning provinces. It actively expands into international markets, especially in Europe, the US, Japan, and South Korea, supported by certifications like FDA, EDQM, PMDA, and REACH. Overseas sales account for over 30% of revenue, with ongoing efforts to increase global market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangxi Fushine Pharmaceutical is positioned mainly in the midstream and upstream segments of the pharmaceutical and lithium battery supply chains, producing raw materials and intermediates. It is also expanding downstream into sterile raw materials and formulations. In the lithium battery sector, it focuses on electrolyte additives and plans to extend into lithium salts and solvents, aiming to build a one-stop supply platform. The microbial protein business represents a new upstream bio-manufacturing initiative.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in pharmaceutical synthesis, including new processes for β-lactamase inhibitors and carbapenem antibiotics, and expanding sterile drug substance capabilities. It invests in R&D for lithium battery additives to improve cost and quality, and in synthetic biology for microbial protein production with proprietary strains and fermentation technologies. Strategic goals include full industry chain integration, product line extension, and international certification to enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct product sales of pharmaceutical raw materials, intermediates, lithium battery electrolyte additives, and microbial protein products. The company employs a direct sales model supported by specialized sales teams and participation in industry exhibitions. It also derives income from government subsidies and investment returns, but product sales constitute the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangxi Fushine Pharmaceutical is a leading domestic and global supplier in the β-lactamase inhibitor and carbapenem antibiotic raw material markets, holding a top position in the Shubatan and Tazobactam product lines. In lithium battery additives, it ranks among the top producers of VC and FEC in China. The company is a pioneer and leader in microbial protein production in China. Competitors include other pharmaceutical raw material manufacturers and chemical suppliers in the new energy sector, but Fushine emphasizes its integrated supply chain and advanced technologies as differentiators.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 1.18 billion, a 26.8% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 272 million, reflecting intensified market competition and cost pressures. Despite the loss, operating cash flow improved significantly. The company has substantial fixed assets valued at over RMB 1.8 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion projects. It maintains a stable shareholder base with over 550 million shares issued and ongoing capital injections.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, cost-effective pharmaceutical raw materials with international certifications (FDA, EDQM, PMDA), ensuring compliance with global standards. Its proprietary enzymatic synthesis technology reduces production costs and enhances safety. In lithium battery additives, it offers mature, reliable products with automotive-grade quality certifications, supporting high-performance batteries. The microbial protein segment provides sustainable, high-protein, low-fat alternatives with patented strains and comprehensive quality certifications, positioning the company as a technology leader and standard-setter in emerging bio-based industries.
